# Columns:  id  kind  file  code-site  statement

#                     compiler actually emits, and the general arity/depth follows by that step.
#          PROPERTY   a syntactic or executable property, discharged by a Scala test rather than by
#                     a prover, because an SMT model of it would be a re-implementation.
#          CITED      already discharged by an obligation OUTSIDE terminating/; the row exists so
#                     the code site is not left looking uncovered.
#          NEGATIVE-RESULT  a kept, annotated FAILED attempt.  Not run by run.sh.
#          OPEN       stated here, NOT discharged.  The reason is in the named file's header.
#          MECHANIZED (proofs/lean/…)  discharged by a Lean-checked theorem; the `file` column names the theorem(s)
#                     and `scripts/check_lean.sh` audits their axioms.  Qualified `PARAMETRIC` when a premise is
#                     left explicit (its own row says which), `PER RUN` when an executable invariant must hold
#                     on the run for the theorem to apply (`SCReport.leanCovered`).
#          ADMITTED   an explicit trusted assumption (docs/TRUSTED.md); none remain after 2E.3.
#          OPEN+DIFFERENTIAL / OPEN+NARROWED / REFUTED-CLOSED / CONSTRUCTION+GATE  variants of OPEN and CITED,
# "TOTAL over the recursion-lowering surface" means: every function that creates, consumes, or
# rewrites a Space.Fixpoint or a recursive Space.Call has at least one row.  The eleven such sites
# Supercompiler.scala {309/473/728 fold/msg/drive}.  Line numbers are as of this change set.
# A row whose kind is OPEN or PROPERTY is NOT a proved obligation.  Read STATUS.tsv for what a
# prover actually said; read the file header for what was attempted and what compensating coverage
